claim_limit: Geometric angle/count census only; not an artistic or in-game quality PASS.

method.angle_source: verify_ev87.edge_angles recomputed on full B and EV95 grids after promoting native float32 heights to float64 (as in v2); B arrays required exact-equal to pinned v2 baseline

population_vertex_masks.bank: EV87._ev87_populations on B cls/reserve/platform plus frozen EV79 wet_support

method.incidence: ANY of the four exact vertices from verify_ev87.edge_vertex_slices; populations overlap at hinge level
method.threshold_new_over30_deg: strict >30.0; this is descriptive, not consumer gate
method.improved_worsened: delta=EV95-B in degrees; improved if delta < -1e-6; worsened if delta > +1e-6; otherwise within tolerance
method.p99: numpy percentile default linear interpolation on concatenated three family arrays
